metadata.description: Skills for keeping an AI assistant honest: verify before advising, audit a whole codebase line by line, ship a release without breaking production, and write like a person.

plugins.name: midesparks-skills
plugins.description: Five skills built while running a live production app solo. check-first: read the artefact that defines a mechanism before explaining it or handing over a procedure. deep-check: audit an entire existing project line by line without faking completeness. release-audit: verify a release actually contains what you think before it reaches users. layman-explain: explain technical, legal and financial things in plain language without softening the real risk. no-ai-slop: strip the tells that make writing read as machine-generated.
